pages.text: The Spawner creates mobs from a filled syringe, FE, and materials supplied by linked $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/matter_beamer)Matter Beamers$(/l). The selected mob determines which materials are accepted.

pages.title: Syringes
pages.text: Use a syringe on the same mob type until it is fully injected, then place it in the spawner. The tooltip shows the stored mob and injection level.

pages.title: Materials
pages.text: The GUI shows three matter buffers. Matter Beamers must send the required materials for the mob in the syringe; unrelated materials are ignored.

pages.title: Efficiency
pages.text: Supply enough FE and keep the beamers stocked. $(5)Infusing$() the spawner improves efficiency, while infusing beamers improves how fast and cheaply they deliver items.
